title: 动森外观 · 自定义透明度控件（560px / 320px，亮暗）

assertions.message: 自定义控件在宽窄两种面板中都不溢出，并使用内嵌卡片
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance')].every((panel) => { const control = panel.querySelector('.animal-island-appearance__custom'); if (!control) return false; const rect = control.getBoundingClientRect(); const style = getComputedStyle(control); return rect.width > 0 && control.scrollWidth <= control.clientWidth + 1 && style.borderStyle === 'solid' && style.borderRadius === '16px'; }))()

assertions.message: 标题和数值占据首行，滑杆独占下一行
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance__slider')].every((slider) => { const title = slider.querySelector('.animal-island-appearance__slider-title'); const value = slider.querySelector('.animal-island-appearance__slider-value'); const input = slider.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if (!title || !value || !input) return false; const titleRect = title.getBoundingClientRect(); const valueRect = value.getBoundingClientRect(); const inputRect = input.getBoundingClientRect(); return getComputedStyle(slider).display === 'grid' && valueRect.left > titleRect.right && inputRect.top >= Math.max(titleRect.bottom, valueRect.bottom) && inputRect.width > 200; }))()

assertions.message: 数值是独立的薄荷强调徽章，滑杆保留自绘轨道且不继承输入框底影
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance__slider')].every((slider) => { const value = slider.querySelector('.animal-island-appearance__slider-value'); const input = slider.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if (!value || !input) return false; const badge = getComputedStyle(value); const dot = getComputedStyle(value, '::before'); const range = getComputedStyle(input); const expectedDot = document.body.hasAttribute('data-ds-dark-theme') ? 'rgb(97, 217, 203)' : 'rgb(25, 200, 185)'; return badge.borderRadius === '999px' && badge.backgroundColor !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && dot.backgroundColor === expectedDot && range.appearance === 'none' && range.boxShadow === 'none'; }))()

assertions.message: 恢复默认是带图标和副标题的次级按钮
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance__reset')].every((button) => { const icon = button.querySelector('.animal-island-appearance__reset-icon svg'); const copy = button.querySelector('.animal-island-appearance__reset-copy'); const subline = copy?.querySelector('small'); if (!icon || !copy || !subline) return false; const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect(); const display = getComputedStyle(button).display; return rect.height >= 36 && button.scrollWidth <= button.clientWidth + 1 && copy.children.length === 2 && subline.textContent.trim() === '均衡 0.40' && (display === 'flex' || display === 'inline-flex'); }))()

assertions.message: diff 语法配色两个选项在宽窄面板内都不溢出，且恰好有一个选中态
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance__diff')].every((group) => { const options = group.querySelector('.animal-island-appearance__diff-options'); const pressed = group.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance__preset[aria-pressed="true"]'); if (!options) return false; return options.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0 && options.scrollWidth <= options.clientWidth + 1 && pressed.length === 1; }))()

assertions.message: 细节三行在宽窄面板内都不溢出，每行恰好一个选中态
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance__details')].every((group) => { const rows = [...group.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance__details-row')]; if (rows.length !== 3) return false; return rows.every((row) => { const options = row.querySelector('.animal-island-appearance__details-options'); const pressed = row.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance__preset[aria-pressed="true"]'); if (!options) return false; return options.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0 && options.scrollWidth <= options.clientWidth + 1 && pressed.length === 1; }); }))()

assertions.message: 全部恢复默认是细节之后的独立动作行
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance')].every((panel) => { const actions = panel.querySelector('.animal-island-appearance__actions'); const details = panel.querySelector('.animal-island-appearance__details'); if (!actions || !details) return false; const order = actions.compareDocumentPosition(details); return Boolean(order & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_PRECEDING) && actions.querySelectorAll('.animal-island-appearance__reset').length === 1; }))()
